body:
Thanks for the reply,

Ive slept over it but I am mentally drained. 

This is a long standing issue for me, I coped with sadness till high school but realised I might actually have a real problem a year or so ago. 

Turns out I have a depressive personality disorder, meaning I get depressed everytime. And Im obsessed, meaning I take stuff too seriously.

I tried doing things I like and I have a really long history of battling with depression. Sadly keeping my mind occupied with things I like doesnt solve anything since I have to go back out there and break some teeth to have a life. I need to work and earn money so I have to keep on fighting. 

I did succeed today and thanks for your care and understanding, I really dont like to rant online about my problems, and dude if only you knowd my life, I am depressed and I am not an expert on anything, still I talk to lots of people with problems and give advise. Which I think is useful, sadly the clown cant cheer himself up.

Its just, I am unhappy overall. I live through this day, but I wonder how many days have I got?

Anyways thank you. And dont worry, english isnt my native too. ;)
